summary: Section 4.2.3, paragraph between [p32-1] and [p32-2]: For a G-module M with trivial G-submodule A and trivial G-quotient B, where G = <tau>, the commutator (tau - 1)(a) = 0 for any a in A. Hence (tau - 1)(g + a) = (tau - 1)(g), so adding elements of A can never eliminate a non-trivial cocycle/action to produce a G-invariant complement H.
